results.title: South Korea’s GC Biopharma Signs MOU with Thai Red Cross Society to Strengthen Plasma-Derived Medicines Workforce in Thailand
results.content: GC Biopharma , a South Korean biopharmaceutical company, announced  that it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Thai Red Cross Society (TRCS) to cooperate on workforce training for the production of plasma-derived medicinal products. This MOU formalizes and deepens a relationship that began in 2015, when GC Biopharma supported TRCS to establish a plasma fractionation facility in Thailand, and reflects the ongoing strategic collaboration between the two parties. Under the terms of the MOU, GC Biopharma and TRCS will jointly develop and operate on-site training and exchange programs for local production personnel. "This MOU is a significant step in broadening the reach of GC Biopharma's advanced technology and production standards across Asia," said Hyoungjun Park, Vice President of GC Biopharma. "Enhancing our personnel's capabilities through specialized training and direct knowledge transfer from GC Biopharma is essential to maintaining the quality, safety, and continuity of plasma-derived medicinal products production in Thailand," said Assoc.
